description: Reconstruct baseline filter audit on saved 512 inputs to create difficult-case strata for separate 768/1024 comparisons.

stratification.failure: Any relevant camera/object: correctly masked object pixels removed >=16 and >=1% of correct masked pixels, OR robot pixels remaining >=64 and >=20% of raw robot pixels; OR previously recorded exact-frame near-finger removal >=10% with at least 5 reference pixels. Failure takes precedence.
stratification.success: No failure and any relevant camera/object has >=128 robot pixels in its raw mask, filter removes >=90%, and correct-pixel loss <=max(16,1% of the correct raw support).
stratification.ordinary: All other successfully audited scenes; includes little robot contamination or borderline cases.
stratification.selection: First allocate one scene per parent in deterministic SHA-256 ordering, then round-robin across parents up to per-parent cap; retain previously audited exact-frame failure before other failure scenes. Strata assigned using only frozen 512 audit and prior 128 audit before comparisons. No replacement based on alternative results.

truth_barrier: 512 truth is explicitly used for scenario stratification only; freeze every 768/1024 policy output before loading its actor labels for evaluation.
